Summary: Minute-Level Rendering, Rapid Delivery

Speed Advantage

Why is it the fastest? Skip footage upload and traditional editing. Our advanced AI analyzes your music and prompt to render and assemble high-quality visuals in the cloud, achieving minute-level delivery instead of hours of waiting.

No Track? No Problem. BeatViz Generates the Music For You.

Our AI Agent works smarter. Even without your audio, it generates original music, sound effects, and dialogue based purely on your vision.

Auto Music Generation

No track? No problem. The BeatViz AI Agent can compose and generate entirely original background music tailored to the mood, genre, and tempo specified in your text prompt, building your video from the ground up.

Intelligent Dialogue & Narration Synthesis

If your video requires a narrative, the Agent will automatically synthesize high-quality human voice dialogue or voiceovers based on your script prompts. Perfect for concept videos, product demos, or story-driven content.

Mood and Genre Analysis

Simply input "melancholic cyberpunk" or "uplifting epic," and the Agent instantly identifies the required emotion and music genre. It then uses this foundation to construct the entire visual and auditory framework for the video.

Automated Audio-Visual Editing

After generating the music, the Agent acts as a professional editor, automatically cutting and arranging visual footage to perfectly match the rhythmic changes and climax points of the new soundtrack, ensuring seamless flow.

All-in-One Storyboard Delivery

In audio-free mode, BeatViz functions as a complete storyboard production tool. It delivers a full concept clip—including original music, voice-over, and custom visuals—in one easy step.

Swap Audio Anytime

Not satisfied with the AI-generated music? No worries. You can upload your own audio at any point, and the Agent will instantly re-sync the visual effects to your new track, ensuring maximum creative flexibility.

Questions and Answers

BeatViz is the ultimate AI video platform that uses the world's best generative AI models (like Veo, Luma, Kling, etc.) to quickly transform audio tracks and text prompts into professionally synchronized, cinematic music videos in minutes, not hours.

Getting started is simple! Just upload your music track (or skip this step if you want the AI to generate sound), enter your desired video style (e.g., "cyberpunk city"), and click 'Generate.' The AI handles the rest.

BeatViz is engineered for speed. By skipping traditional editing and relying on our high-performance cloud AI engine, you can expect to go from a prompt to a finished, synced video in minutes, not weeks.

BeatViz is the fastest and most cost-effective way to create professional-grade music visuals. It eliminates the need for expensive crews, complex software skills, and hours of manual beat-syncing.

Our proprietary BeatViz AI Agent performs deep analysis of your uploaded audio, detecting the BPM, rhythm changes, and emotional arcs. It then ensures all visual cuts and scene transitions align with your music at a millisecond level of precision.

Yes. If you don't upload a track, the BeatViz AI Agent will automatically generate scene-appropriate background music, sound effects, or dialogue based on your text description, delivering a complete acoustic and visual narrative.

None at all. BeatViz is designed for a zero-hassle user experience. If you can type a prompt and upload a file, you can create a high-quality music video.

Because we utilize a matrix of top AI models (Veo, Kling, Pika, etc.) and give you full control over prompt, model selection, and style, your output is a unique combination of your creative input and the most advanced AI algorithms, ensuring original results.

Yes. Videos generated through a paid BeatViz subscription come with full commercial usage rights. You can use them for promotion, monetization on platforms like YouTube, and advertising campaigns.

Videos generated under our paid plans are completely free of watermarks. Free trial videos may include a temporary watermark.

BeatViz offers various subscription tiers, typically including a free tier or a free trial period for testing the core functionality and speed. Please check our Pricing page for the current options.

You can easily reach our support team via the Contact Us page on our website. We also encourage you to join our Community channels for quick peer-to-peer support and tips.
